charts.name: The Bahamas reference chart of accounts
charts.legal_reference: There is no statutory chart of accounts in The Bahamas in the texts consulted. The Value Added Tax Act, 2014, requires a registrant to account for output tax, input tax and the net amount payable for each tax period (ss. 46 and 47) and to hold the invoice, credit note or import declaration behind every input tax claim (s. 50(1)(d) and (e)). This chart is original: four digits, blocked so that each range reaches one line of the IFRS-style statements, with the accounts a Bahamian company keeps — a Bahamian dollar current account and a foreign currency account, VAT output and input tax, the net VAT settlement account, VAT collected by Customs on imports, VAT withheld under section 23A, and National Insurance. The Bahamas has no income tax on companies or individuals: the accounts for income taxes are for taxes paid abroad and for the domestic minimum top-up tax of large multinational groups.

numbering.legal_reference: Value Added Tax Act, 2014, s. 54(1) and (3)(a) — a registrant supplier issues to a registrant recipient an original VAT invoice within sixty calendar days, in the form and with the particulars the Comptroller prescribes, and only one VAT invoice for a taxable supply; a copy is marked "copy" (s. 54(4)). The Act asks for one invoice per supply and not for a series without gaps, which is why the style is `sequential`. The particulars the Comptroller prescribes are in the VAT Rules on the content of invoices and receipts, which were not read.

tax_point.legal_reference: The time of supply is section 32 of the Act (rules relating to time of supply), which was not read for this pack. `invoice_date` is declared as a convention of this pack and not as a rule of the law; a payment or a deposit received before the invoice may bring the supply forward, and is recorded as a gap in the README.

einvoicing.legal_reference: None of the texts consulted (the VAT Act and its amendments to 2025, the Department's guidance on invoices, sales receipts, credit notes and debit notes, its payment page) imposes a structured electronic invoice or a clearance system: a VAT invoice is a document with prescribed particulars (s. 54) and the return is filed online. No Peppol authority or published profile was found, so `profile`, `party_scheme` and `vat_scheme` are null and `obligation` is `none`.

not_taxed.legal_reference: Value Added Tax Act, 2014, s. 45 — a taxable importation of services is taxed: the importer or recipient submits a VAT return and pays the VAT within seven calendar days of the import (recipient not a taxable person), on the date in the notice of assessment (unregistered taxable person) or within twenty-one calendar days after the tax period (registrant). The pack carries no code for the self-charge: the services that are taxable on import, the value they are taxed on and the matching input tax claim are for the user and the accountant, and are recorded as a gap in the README.
